title: To designate the Federal building and United States courthouse located at 121 Spring Street SE in Gainesville, Georgia, as the "Sidney Oslin Smith, Jr. Federal Building and United States Courthouse".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the House passed version is repeated here.)

(Sec. 1) This bill designates the federal building and U.S. courthouse located at 121 Spring Street S.E. in Gainesville, Georgia, as the "Sidney Oslin Smith, Jr. Federal Building and United States Courthouse."

summary.headline: Names a federal building and courthouse in Gainesville, Georgia, after the late judge Sidney Oslin Smith, Jr.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the federal building and U.S. courthouse at 121 Spring Street S.E. in Gainesville, Georgia. The new name is the "Sidney Oslin Smith, Jr. Federal Building and United States Courthouse." It changes only the official name of the building and does not change how the building is used or run.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2016.
